whatIsSection.subtitle: Missing teeth treatment includes various dental procedures designed to replace one or more lost teeth, restore proper function, improve appearance, and maintain overall oral health.

whyMattersBox.title: Why Timely Replacement Matters
whyMattersBox.paragraph: Delaying treatment for missing teeth can lead to complications that affect your bite, jawbone, and overall oral health. Early replacement helps prevent these issues.

items.title: Prevents Bone Loss
items.description: The jawbone begins to shrink without a tooth root to stimulate it, which can affect facial structure over time.

items.title: Maintains Bite Alignment
items.description: Neighboring teeth can shift into the gap, disrupting your bite and making chewing more difficult.

items.title: Protects Remaining Teeth
items.description: Gaps can place excess stress on neighboring teeth, increasing wear and risk of damage.

items.title: Preserves Facial Structure
items.description: Timely replacement helps maintain natural facial support and appearance.

items.question: What is the best treatment for missing teeth?
items.answer: The best treatment depends on your oral health, number of missing teeth, and personal preferences. Dental implants, bridges, and dentures are among the most common options.

items.question: Are dental implants better than dentures?
items.answer: Dental implants offer greater stability, durability, and a more natural feel, while dentures provide an affordable solution for replacing multiple missing teeth.

items.question: How long does missing teeth treatment take?
items.answer: Treatment duration varies depending on the selected procedure. Dentures and bridges may require a few appointments, while dental implants typically take several months due to healing time.

items.question: Is replacing missing teeth necessary?
items.answer: Yes. Replacing missing teeth helps restore chewing ability, prevents neighboring teeth from shifting, preserves jawbone health, and improves overall oral function.

items.question: How much does missing teeth treatment cost in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the number of missing teeth, treatment type, implant requirements, and restorative materials. A consultation provides a personalized estimate.

items.question: Can I replace a single missing tooth?
items.answer: Yes. A single missing tooth can be replaced with a dental implant or a dental bridge, depending on your oral condition.
